replies.author: FailedGradAdmissions
replies.body:
Then you better go and study multithreading and parallelization right now, and also purchase several different powerful machine to test on.

Even if you do get Claude to somehow write performant code without race conditions, you’ll need equipment to test on. The optimizations you can do on a 5090 don’t transfer to a 4080, sometimes not even to a 5080. And that’s both Nvidia cards, remember there’s AMD, ARC and ARM.

Making sure a game plays properly in all possible devices is a hard problem. So even AAA just optimize for a common denominator. Say a 3060 with 16GB of RAM. But as a result, the game won’t take advantage of any extra available compute if you run it on a more powerful machine.

Having an 8GB M1 as a target is not a hard constraint, on the contrary if that’s your target it should run as well on better hardware. But it may not unless you optimize for it in specific and then test it.
